title: Fix design-review findings on the Remotes pane and the globe badge
body:
Fix the design-review findings on the Settings > Remotes pane (src/remotes_pane.rs, added by commit 991533a). A designer reviewed the pane from code and refused sign-off on two points; fix both, plus the listed polish. No new features, no change to the settings model or the probe.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-remote-sessions-design.md (sections: UI > Reachability, UI > Settings > Remotes). House style to match: the Keybindings pane (how it draws a conflict error, its left edge, its hint line).
Blocked by: Remotes pane in Settings with Test and reachability
Blocking fixes:
1. Validation errors. Today every message is drawn dim in the footer (RemotesView::show), so "Give the Remote a name" looks like "Saved desk", and the Esc arm of Mode::Edit in RemotesView::key leaves the message behind after cancel. Draw a validation error inside the form frame under the fields in the theme danger colour, the way Keybindings draws a conflict; move the form focus (d.field) to the offending field; clear the message on cancel. Keep the footer for Saved / Deleted only.
2. Width. render_form puts Name (110) + Target (190) + Shell + three labels in one non-wrapping horizontal row, wider than PANE_MIN_W (360), and the ScrollArea is vertical only, so the Shell control is clipped at narrow sizes. Stack the form as label/field rows sized from available_width(). In render_rows the name and "target Â· shell" text are painted with no width limit and run under the right-hand status and buttons: lay out the right-hand controls first, truncate the text into what is left, and show the full value on hover.
Polish (do all; each is small):
- No layout jumps: reserve a fixed line for the Test progress/result under a row and for the ~/.ssh/config suggestion strip, so rows do not shift when a result arrives or Target gains focus.
- The Unknown and Offline reasons are hover-only; also show the reason on the selected row's second line so a keyboard user can read it.
- Opening the add form (begin_add) must select and scroll to the form; with many Remotes it opens below the fold today.
- read_keys must ignore A/D/T/J/K when a modifier is held (Ctrl+D must not open the delete confirm).
- Copy: the browse hint must not offer "Enter edit / T test / Del delete" on the Add row or an empty list; reword the Offline tooltip ("it stays clickable" is launcher wording); TestOutcome::summary says "which only a pane can do" - "pane" is an avoided word in CONTEXT.md and names no action, say to open a Remote Session on it once and log in there; make shell names and button label casing consistent with the sibling panes.
- The Test result line is indented with three literal spaces, so wrapped lines fall back to x=0; indent with layout instead. Match the left edge the Keybindings pane uses.
- render_form calls request_focus every frame regardless of whether the settings Win is active; gate it so typing in a terminal Win cannot land in the Name field.
Done when:
- a validation error is drawn in the form in the danger colour, focus is on the bad field, and Esc leaves no message behind (unit test on the pure model)
- at PANE_MIN_W the whole form is reachable and no row text overlaps the status or buttons (a test that lays the pane out at that width through egui::Context::run, like frame_with_key in settings_menu.rs tests, and asserts the form widgets' rects are inside the pane rect)
- a modifier-held letter does nothing (unit test)
- existing remotes_pane and settings_menu tests still pass
- the final report lists which states the human should capture with build-screenshot: narrow window with the add form, a long target row, empty list, the four probe states side by side, Test passed / needs login / long failure, the delete confirm
Second part, same card: design-review fixes on the globe badge (commit 5e31c92: src/icons.rs, assets/icons/globe.svg, src/wm.rs, src/terminal.rs, src/remote.rs).
Blocking:
G1. The globe is unreadable at 100% scaling. icons::paint_globe_badge draws it at icon.width() * 0.62 (about 8.7 pt on the 14 pt tab icon, 7.4 pt on the 12 pt panel icon); the SVG's 2.6-unit stroke and its gaps are each about 1 device px, and the texture is drawn into an unrounded, unsnapped rect with linear filtering, so it is resampled into a blue dot. Snap the badge size and origin to whole device pixels ((d * ppp).round() / ppp), and below about 12 device px draw a simpler glyph (ring plus one meridian and the equator, no ellipse) or raise the factor to about 0.72 with a thinner stroke. Keep it a white silhouette that is tinted.
Polish:
- GLOBE_TINT (110,180,255) is nearly the PowerShell icon tint (83,145,254), and the backing disc covers the underscore of terminal.svg. Tint the globe from the theme text colour instead of a hard-coded colour, and fix the doc comment that claims it reads apart from every shell tint.
- wm.rs remote_lead / remote_row: the close confirm lead ends in a colon and then lists one row with the local ssh pid, which means nothing to the user. Drop the colon and show the Remote's target instead of the pid.
- terminal.rs image_paste_refusal tells the user to copy the image "on desk", where they are not sitting. Say that the agent reads the Remote's clipboard and to save the image there and give it the path.
- wm.rs show_tab_overflow paints the badge but never shows remote::badge_tooltip; add it.
- remote::badge_tooltip "On desk (target)" reads as English "on desk"; use "Remote: desk (target)".
Done when (globe): a unit test shows the badge rect is on whole device pixels at pixels_per_point 1.0, 1.25 and 1.5; the final report adds these screenshot states: tab strip at 100%, 125% and 150% with a Remote Claude, Codex and PowerShell tab (active, inactive, hovered), a Sessions-panel row, the overflow list, the close confirm, the image-paste toast.
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent settings_menu; cargo test --target-dir target/agent remote; cargo test --target-dir target/agent icons
